analysis.title: Market Rhythm
key_insights: S&P 500 bounced but intraday gains were scarce and the cash session did not forge a major low. Bulls need intraday strength and a 200dma reclaim at 7,350.
Nasdaq 100 gained 6.86% and reclaimed 26,165, the January high and breakout level, but the candle closed black and it stays below major resistance. More is needed to confirm a durable low.

Philadelphia Semiconductors gained 14.0% but the small black candle leaves the downtrend intact. RSI shows bullish divergence, the 9,205 gap is key support and a break of the downtrend at 9,900 would strengthen the bull case.

Nvidia gained 31.5% with a positive RSI signal, but the black candle points to intraday selling. Gap resistance at 170/171 rejected the first attempt, above it the target is 185, support is 157 then 144.
KOSPI formed a bullish three-day abandoned baby reversal and reclaimed the 5,000 area. The first downtrend sits near 5,140 with more resistance overhead.
TOPIX shows RSI bullish divergence after a lower low but failed to reclaim the 3,795 gap. It stays vulnerable below 3,905, where the 50dma meets the downtrend.
Hang Seng China Enterprises is back at June's closing lows. Key support is 7,405 and a decisive break would worsen the picture, with bulls needing an oversold bounce.
Euro Stoxx 50 avoided oversold conditions and posted genuine intraday gains despite a smaller percentage rebound. It remains vulnerable below the gap and 200dma resistance at 6,114/29.
Gold (XAUUSD 3,650) broke key supports last week and tested major support at 3,500. A technical rebound could emerge soon with initial resistance at 3,700-3,710.
EURUSD (1.0900) remains under pressure below 1.1000 with next support at 1.0850/45. Oversold signals could limit downside even if support breaks.

Gold could break major support at 3,500 after last week's breakdown.
vol_and_positioning: Europe avoided oversold conditions during the selloff, unlike other regions, per the technical read.
Oversold signals on EURUSD could limit downside even if 1.0850/45 support breaks.
Hang Seng China Enterprises needs an oversold bounce from June's closing lows.
